notes: A driving game with a route and a finish is Racing, and the answer picked a run that ends somewhere different from its start, so route-point-to-point. Downhill Descent is the point-to-point preset whose mode actually matches a long cross-country stage where the terrain underfoot is the story, so it was taken over Sprint / Drag, whose lane ropes and painted corridors describe a straight-line drag strip this is not; startpoint-line and trigger-finish were added because the preset states neither end of the run. Three environments along one continuous route is not three maps: the answer says the route moves through them, so this stays on the genre-wide P6 with no P4, and settlement-density carries the city leg. No option expresses grip, so the stated surface change is recorded here for the pipeline: pavement in the city, loose sand in the desert, slippery snow and ice in the third leg, in that order along the route.
